answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the ripple check immediately, the river audit keeps the resolved set and the harbor replay exposes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 66 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 66 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
